meta.data: Alpaca free plan, SIP daily bars, total-return adjusted (adjustment=all). Prices are not redistributed; this file contains derived results only.
meta.convention: Signal at close t, weights applied from t+1, flat proportional costs on turnover, cash and financing earn BIL. Weights are not drifted between rebalances.
meta.frozen_parameters: All parameters are the cited papers' defaults; none was tuned on this sample.
meta.caveat: Survivorship: the ETF universe is today's list of liquid ETFs. 2016-2026 is one US-centric regime. A deflated Sharpe near 0.5 means 'indistinguishable from the best of several coin flips'.

strategies.name: Equal weight (1/N)
strategies.blurb: Monthly rebalanced 1/N across the universe — the hard-to-beat baseline.

strategies.name: Time-series momentum
strategies.blurb: Long assets with positive 12-1 month return, short the rest; each position sized to 15% volatility.
refs: Hurst, Ooi, Pedersen (2017), JPM — A century of evidence on trend-following

strategies.name: Dual momentum
strategies.blurb: Hold the 5 strongest 12-1 month assets, but only those with positive absolute momentum; the rest sits in cash.

strategies.name: 10-month trend filter
strategies.blurb: Equal slot per asset, invested only while price is above its 210-day average.
refs: Faber (2007), JWM — A quantitative approach to tactical asset allocation

strategies.name: Volatility-managed equity
strategies.blurb: SPY scaled by the inverse of last month's realised volatility (15% target, 2x cap).
refs: Cederburg et al. (2020), JFE — critique: out-of-sample gains are fragile

strategies.name: Risk parity (inverse vol)
strategies.blurb: Weights proportional to 1/volatility, long-only, no leverage.
refs: Asness, Frazzini, Pedersen (2012), FAJ — Leverage aversion and risk parity

strategies.name: Hierarchical risk parity
strategies.blurb: Cluster by correlation, then split risk down the tree — no covariance inversion.
refs: Lopez de Prado (2016), JPM — Building diversified portfolios that outperform out of sample

strategies.name: Residual reversal stat-arb
strategies.blurb: Dollar-neutral: buy assets that fell vs. the market over 5 days, sell those that rose. Daily turnover makes costs decisive.
refs: Avellaneda, Lee (2010), Quant. Finance — Statistical arbitrage in the US equities market

strategies.name: Multi-strategy blend
strategies.blurb: Inverse-volatility blend of every strategy above (except the 1/N benchmark) — fixed recipe, no performance selection.
refs: Diversification across low-correlation return streams (Markowitz 1952; DeMiguel et al. 2009)
